Name: cavalab Code-15 ResNet DeepSurv (no demographics)
Summary: Ribeiro ResNet1d with a fusion MLP emitting one Cox log-risk for all-cause mortality.

Model properties.Input: 12-lead surface ECG, middle 7 s at 400 Hz zero-padded to 4096 samples

x-mival.notes: unverified: weights uri/sha ('Code15 ResNet DeepSurv no Dem.pt', 30.5 MB), builder, input unit (CODE-15 native scale; check mV vs 1e-4 V). Code GPL-3.0, weights CC-BY-4.0. Per-lead z-score uses the checkpoint's stored NM/NS, not the cohort's own statistics. x-mival.output 'regression' is the nearest existing value: a log-risk read as a continuous target, wrong in meaning. No baseline hazard is shipped.

output.baseline_hazard: not shipped; fit (Breslow) on a cohort = recalibration, or report discrimination only
